# Workbooks (printable PDF activity books)

A **workbook** is a printable activity book for young children (pre-K to grade 2): shape lessons, tracing, colouring, counting, find-the-shapes, matching, mazes, dot-to-dot, word searches, patterns and drawing prompts, drawn as black line art on white with the Stickman characters. One workbook script makes several PDFs: usually the student book and its answer key. The engine builds every puzzle from the seed, so you choose what goes on each page and it makes the maze, the word grid and the answers.

## How to write a good workbook

- **One idea per page.** Give each page a short title ("Find the Stars") and, when useful, one or two short sentences a grown-up reads aloud ("Colour every star. How many are there?"). Pre-K and K pages hold one or two activities.
- **Build up.** Introduce a shape (shape_lesson), then trace it, find it, count it, colour it and use it in a pattern or a picture. Mix quiet pages (tracing, colouring) with puzzles (mazes, dot-to-dot, word searches).
- **Fit the grade.** Pre-K: big single shapes, counting to 5, small mazes, no word searches, capital letters. K: counting to 10, 7 x 7 mazes, 6 x 6 word searches, capitals and short words. Grades 1-2: more shapes and dots, bigger mazes and grids, lowercase words.
- **Use the cast.** Put the book's characters on the cover, beside page titles (page `art`), at maze ends and in colouring pages and patterns. Only print-approved names (listed below) work.
- **Every puzzle gets its key.** Add one document `{ "id": "answers", "answersFor": "student" }`; the engine fills it with the pages that have answers.
- **Family friendly.** Gentle words, no fighting or scary themes, nothing about weapons.

## Before you answer, check

1. `"kind": "workbook"`, `"version": 1`, a `grade`, a `seed`, a `title`; ids lowercase_with_underscores and unique.
2. Every activity name, shape, picture, dot picture, colour, preset, pose, prop and object comes from these tables.
3. Numbers stay within the grade rules (count, maze size, dots); word search words are letters only and fit the grid.
4. Each block's `slot` exists in its page's `layout`, one block per slot.
5. A colour_by_shape key names only shapes in its picture; a pattern's repeat matches its number of pictures (ABC takes 3).
6. The answer key document points at the student book.

## Script format

```
{
  "kind": "workbook", "version": 1,
  "title": str<=60, "seed": int, "grade": "prek"|"k"|"1"|"2",
  "page": { "size": "letter"|"a4" (default letter), "margin": 27-72, "orientation": "portrait"|"landscape" },
  "style": { "cast": [preset ids], "nameLine": true, "pageNumbers": true },
  "documents": [
    { "id": "student", "title": str, "cover": { "subtitle": str, "art": [1-4 art refs] },
      "pages": [ { "id": "lowercase_id", "title": str<=40, "instructions": str, "layout": layout,
                   "art": { "preset", "pose", "face" } (beside the title, optional),
                   "blocks": [ { "activity": name, "slot": 0 | [first, last], "instructions": str, ...params } ] } ] },
    { "id": "answers", "answersFor": "student", "title": str, "cover": { "subtitle": "Answer Key" } }
  ]
}
```

Layouts (slots in reading order): full (1), halves (2), thirds (3), grid2x2 (4), grid2x3 (6). A block's `slot` picks one; a span `[0, 1]` covers both. One block per slot.

Art references: `{"preset": id, "pose": p, "face": f, "facing": 1|-1}`, `{"prop": name}`, `{"object": name}`, `{"shape": name, "rotate": deg}`.

## Activities

| activity | what the child does | params | answer key | example block |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| shape_lesson | One shape big with its corners dotted, its name and facts, three dashed copies to trace and three things in real life with that shape. | shape | none | `{"activity":"shape_lesson","shape":"triangle"}` |
| trace_shapes | One row per shape: dashed copies that fade across the row, the first with a green start dot. | shapes (1-6), rows (default one per shape) | none | `{"activity":"trace_shapes","shapes":["circle","square","triangle"]}` |
| trace_letters | Letters, digits or a short word on handwriting lines: a model with numbered start dots and arrows, then fading dashed copies, then room to write alone. | text (letters, digits, spaces; up to 16), rows (default as many as fit) | none | `{"activity":"trace_letters","text":"cat","rows":3}` |
| colour_page | One to four big line-art pictures (characters, props, objects, shapes) on a ground line to colour in. | art (1-4 art references), ground (default true) | none | `{"activity":"colour_page","art":[{"preset":"doopi","pose":"waveA"}]}` |
| colour_by_shape | A picture made of shapes with a key below (shape = crayon colour); the child colours each shape by the key. | picture (a shape picture), key {shape: colour} (default one crayon per shape) | the picture coloured in | `{"activity":"colour_by_shape","picture":"house","key":{"square":"red","triangle":"blue","rectangle":"brown","circle":"yellow"}}` |
| find_shapes | A target shape scattered among other shapes; the child colours every target and writes how many. | target, count (grade limit), distractors (1-5 shapes), others (default count + 2), askCount (default true) | targets circled, the count | `{"activity":"find_shapes","target":"star","count":5,"distractors":["circle","heart"]}` |
| count | Rows of the same picture to count, each with a box for the number. | item (an art reference), groups (1-6 numbers, grade limit) | the numbers | `{"activity":"count","item":{"shape":"heart"},"groups":[3,5,2]}` |
| match | Two columns; the child draws a line from each picture or word on the left to its partner on the right (shuffled). | pairs (2-6 of [left, right]; each an art reference or {"text"}) | the lines | `{"activity":"match","pairs":[[{"shape":"circle"},{"text":"circle"}],[{"shape":"star"},{"text":"star"}],[{"shape":"square"},{"text":"square"}]]}` |
| maze | A maze from a picture on the left to a picture on the right, with exactly one path. | size [columns, rows] (default the grade's largest), start, end (art references) | the path | `{"activity":"maze","start":{"preset":"doopi"},"end":{"object":"mushroom_hut"}}` |
| dot_to_dot | Numbered dots to join in order, round a shape's outline or a dot picture. | subject {"shape"} or {"picture"} (a dot picture), points (shapes only, grade limit) | the outline | `{"activity":"dot_to_dot","subject":{"picture":"fish"}}` |
| word_search | Hidden words in a letter grid with a tick list (right and down; grade 2 adds diagonals). Not for pre-K. | words (3-12, letters only), size (default the grade's grid) | each word marked | `{"activity":"word_search","words":["cat","dog","pig","hen"]}` |
| pattern | A repeating row of pictures with empty boxes at the end; the child draws what comes next. | sequence (2-3 art references), repeat (AB, AAB, ABB, ABC), length (4-10, default 8), blanks (1-3, default 2) | the missing pictures | `{"activity":"pattern","sequence":[{"shape":"circle"},{"shape":"square"}]}` |
| draw_prompt | A drawing prompt above a framed box, with an optional picture to start from. | prompt (up to 80 characters), starter (an art reference) | none | `{"activity":"draw_prompt","prompt":"Draw a hat for Mooka.","starter":{"preset":"mooka"}}` |

## Grade rules

| rule | prek | k | 1 | 2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| blocks per page (more: warning) | 1 | 2 | 4 | 6 |
| instruction length (characters) | 50 | 60 | 90 | 120 |
| count / find: most per group | 5 | 10 | 20 | 20 |
| maze: largest side | 5 | 7 | 10 | 14 |
| dot-to-dot: most dots | 10 | 15 | 25 | 40 |
| word search grid | none | 6 x 6 | 8 x 8 | 10 x 10 |

## Names you can use

**Shape pictures** (colour_by_shape `picture`): house (square, triangle, rectangle, circle); rocket (rectangle, triangle, circle, right_triangle, star); fish (oval, triangle, circle); robot (square, circle, heart, rectangle); tree (rectangle, triangle, star).

**Dot pictures** (dot_to_dot `{"picture"}`): fish (14 dots, grade k), sailboat (12 dots, grade k), house (11 dots, grade k), rocket (11 dots, grade k), cat (11 dots, grade k).

**Crayon colours**: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, brown, grey, black.

**Characters** (`{"preset"}`, print-approved): becky (dog), bn_mooka (person), bo (person), bobo (person), brute (person), crowd_adult (person), crowd_kid (person), dony (person), doomi (person), doopi (person), ghoom (person), goon (person), guard (person), kai (person), kanta (person), kony (person), mallu (person), mirchi (person), mooka (person), motumal (person), nani (person), peepa (person), pip (person), rook (person), sage (person), sly (person), tam (person), tara (person), thunda (person), tony (person), tutu (person), vex (person), zizi (person). Poses for people: stand, waveA, victory, pointPose, sit, flexPose, laughA, danceA1 (default stand); dogs: dog_stand, dog_sit, dog_beg. Faces: neutral, happy, laugh, sad, cry, angry, furious, scared, surprised, determined (default happy).

**Objects** (`{"object"}`): balloon, basket, bench, bike, book, box, bubble, bubble_wand, bus, bush, cage, cake, campfire, cane, car, cart, chair, crystal_ball, crystal_socket, dhol, door, fishing_net, flower, football, fountain, garden_wall, giant_pot, gloom_horn, hanging_cage, haystack, ice_cream, jalebi, jalebi_plate, kite, ladle, lamppost, lantern_string, lever, lookout_tower, market_stall, mirror, mushroom_hut, phone, picnic_blanket, pillow, pirate_ship, pot_and_pan, racket, raft, rainbow_crystal, ribbon, rock_round, rope, rope_bridge, rowboat, sign, snowball, table, tennis_ball, tennis_net, treasure_chest, tree_big, triangle, trumpet, watering_can, windup_key, yoga_mat.

## Validator codes

- E_SCHEMA_REQUIRED: a required field is missing → Add the field the message names.
- E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN_FIELD: a field that does not exist → Remove it or use the suggested name.
- E_SCHEMA_ENUM: a value not in the allowed list → Use a value the message lists.
- E_TEXT_BLOCKED: a blocked word → Reword it.
- W_TEXT_SOFT: a strong word for the audience → Use the suggested word.
- E_KIND: a script kind that does not exist → "kind": "workbook" for a printable workbook; no kind for a video script.
- E_WB_ID: a document or page id used twice → Give each document, and each page of a document, its own id.
- E_WB_ANSWERS_FOR: an answer key for a document that does not exist or has no pages → Set answersFor to the id of a document with pages.
- E_WB_SLOT: a block in a slot the layout does not have, or two blocks in one slot → Use the layout's slots (full 1, halves 2, thirds 3, grid2x2 4, grid2x3 6), one block each.
- E_WB_ART: an unknown or unapproved preset, pose, face, prop or object → Use print-approved art from 09_workbooks.md; four-legged presets take dog_ poses.
- E_WB_SHAPE: an unknown 2D shape → Use a shape from 09_workbooks.md.
- E_WB_GRADE: a number over the grade's limit (count, maze size, dot points) → Stay within the grade rules in 09_workbooks.md.
- E_WB_PICTURE: an unknown shape picture → Use a shape picture from 09_workbooks.md.
- E_WB_COLOUR: a colour that is not a catalog crayon colour → Use red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, brown, grey or black.
- E_WB_LETTER: a character with no tracing letter → Trace letters A-Z and a-z, digits 0-9 and spaces.
- E_WB_PATTERN: a pattern with the wrong number of pictures for its repeat → AB, AAB and ABB take 2 pictures; ABC takes 3.
- E_WB_WORD: a word search word that is not letters only, is blocked, or is longer than the grid → Short family-friendly words, letters only.
- E_WB_FIT: an activity's pictures, words or dots do not fit in its slot → Use fewer items, or a bigger slot (full or halves).
- W_WB_TEXT: instructions long for the grade → One or two short sentences a grown-up can read aloud.
- W_WB_DENSE: more activities on one page than the grade can handle → Split them over more pages (pre-K 1, K 2, grade 1 4, grade 2 6).
- W_WB_REPEAT: the same activity with the same params twice in a document → Change the params so every page is new.

## Example

A K workbook (student book and answer key):
```json
{"kind":"workbook","version":1,"title":"A Day on the Farm","seed":517455372,"grade":"k","style":{"cast":["doopi","becky"]},"documents":[{"id":"student","title":"A Day on the Farm","cover":{"subtitle":"With Doopi and Becky the dog","art":[{"preset":"doopi","pose":"waveA"},{"object":"haystack"},{"preset":"becky","pose":"dog_sit"}]},"pages":[{"id":"good_morning","title":"Good Morning, Farm!","instructions":"Colour Doopi, Becky and the haystack.","blocks":[{"activity":"colour_page","art":[{"preset":"doopi","pose":"waveA"},{"preset":"becky","pose":"dog_stand"},{"object":"haystack"}]}]},{"id":"count_hay","title":"Count the Haystacks","instructions":"How many in each row? Write the number.","art":{"preset":"becky","pose":"dog_sit"},"blocks":[{"activity":"count","item":{"object":"haystack"},"groups":[2,4,3]}]},{"id":"find_doopi","title":"Help Becky Find Doopi","instructions":"Draw a line from Becky to Doopi.","blocks":[{"activity":"maze","start":{"preset":"becky","pose":"dog_stand"},"end":{"preset":"doopi","pose":"waveA"}}]},{"id":"farm_words","title":"Farm Animal Words","instructions":"Find each word. Tick it off.","blocks":[{"activity":"word_search","words":["cow","pig","hen","duck","dog"]}]},{"id":"trace_animals","title":"Trace the Animals","layout":"halves","blocks":[{"activity":"trace_letters","text":"cow","rows":2},{"slot":1,"activity":"trace_letters","text":"pig","rows":2}]},{"id":"dots_barn","title":"Join the Dots","instructions":"Start at 1. What is it?","blocks":[{"activity":"dot_to_dot","subject":{"picture":"house"}}]},{"id":"patterns","title":"What Comes Next?","instructions":"Draw what comes next.","layout":"halves","blocks":[{"activity":"pattern","sequence":[{"object":"flower"},{"object":"watering_can"}],"length":6},{"slot":1,"activity":"pattern","sequence":[{"shape":"heart"},{"shape":"star"},{"shape":"circle"}],"length":6,"blanks":2}]},{"id":"match_farm","title":"Match the Words","instructions":"Draw a line to the word.","blocks":[{"activity":"match","pairs":[[{"preset":"becky","pose":"dog_stand"},{"text":"dog"}],[{"object":"haystack"},{"text":"hay"}],[{"object":"cart"},{"text":"cart"}],[{"object":"flower"},{"text":"flower"}]]}]},{"id":"find_hearts","title":"Find the Hearts","instructions":"Colour every heart. How many?","blocks":[{"activity":"find_shapes","target":"heart","count":6,"distractors":["circle","star"]}]},{"id":"farmhouse","title":"Colour the Farmhouse","instructions":"Colour each shape with its crayon.","blocks":[{"activity":"colour_by_shape","picture":"house","key":{"square":"red","triangle":"brown","rectangle":"yellow","circle":"orange"}}]},{"id":"draw_pig","title":"Draw a Farm Friend","blocks":[{"activity":"draw_prompt","prompt":"Draw a pig playing in the mud with Becky.","starter":{"preset":"becky","pose":"dog_sit"}}]}]},{"id":"answers","answersFor":"student","title":"A Day on the Farm","cover":{"subtitle":"Answer Key"}}]}
```
